<!-- pr-reviewer: c6b66a532386a9c6e7d29391d44e39f0e1621977 -->

**Verdict: merge-ready.** Second look under the safety floor, independent of the author. Built on a merged tree (head c6b66a532 + main 110aca435; the trial merge is clean, `mergeable` MERGEABLE).

Evidence run here:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test contour_whole`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test contour_whole_step --test real_tip_contour`: 3 passed + 4 passed, 0 failed. The three `case1/case2/refusal` pins named red-before-fix are green on the merged tree.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets`: clean at head. The one warning is main's own `heights.rs:128` lint (#2479), not from this PR.

Code reading: every branch of the band loop fails closed. An unreadable plane names the stopped level and the skipped Zs (`check_unread`); a split at the band's first level after the fallback still used gives a refusal "cannot cut ... without gouging" with the ring reasons; a region transform that fails names the stopped Z. A partial path rides each refusal as a ghost - the diagnostic is visible, never silent (Prime Directive). The counterbore case is handled where it belongs: a hole ring ending opens the search for a narrower hole at that level (`first_split`), so the lower bore is walked, not dropped. The per-band union of `contour_reach` keeps the stock-carry check honest for the deeper silhouettes - the right call for the safety floor.

Notes, not blockers:
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs` grew from 473 to 514 lines. It was already over the 400-line rule on main; this PR is not the cause, but the split is owed. I am filing the P7 note.
- `match_pick` defers on the strings "farther than" and "no contour ring". A rename of those messages must update it. Acceptable; the pins cover both paths.
- `Side::Inside` delegates to the single-band path unchanged, as the body states.

Labels: `merge-ready`. A `fix`: merges when the batch gate is green.
